intro_heading: Help AI understand how you write
intro_body: Kilmeh is an open benchmark that tests whether AI coding assistants understand Arabic. We need real spellings from native speakers across the Arab world. You will see 10 English words, one at a time. For each one, write how you would say it in Arabic letters and in Arabizi (Arabic written with Latin letters and numbers, like 3, 7 and 2). It takes about five minutes, and there are no wrong answers: write it the way you and your friends would.
help_optional_identity: Only if you want to be credited or contacted. Your email is never published or shown again.
label_country: Which country's Arabic do you speak?
help_country: Choose the country your Arabic comes from, even if you live somewhere else.

help_credit: Type your name above to turn this on.

err_arabizi_script: Use Latin letters and numbers here, not Arabic letters.
err_formula: Please do not start with = + - or @, because spreadsheets can treat that as a formula.
label_keep_english: Keep this word in English (we do not translate it)
help_keep_english: Then Arabic letters are optional. Still write how you spell it in Latin letters.
feminine_note: If this changes when you talk to a woman, or when a woman says it, write that form too.
